outside_scope_observations.observation: playback_rate_option is rendered with rate: String(rate), so the option reads "0.5x", "1.5x", "2x" in fr — a full stop where fr requires a decimal comma ("1,5x"). The catalogue cannot fix it: {rate} is injected verbatim and "{rate}x" is the audited value. Shared code defect, affects every locale whose decimal separator is not '.'.
outside_scope_observations.action: source fix (Intl.NumberFormat(locale)), not a catalogue change; no byte of this namespace should move for it.
